name: GCM Capital Advisors Limited
about: GCM Capital Advisors Limited, a financial services company, provides financial advisory and consultancy services in India. It engages in investment in shares and securities, commercial papers, fixed deposits, and other related activities of capital markets, as well as treasury operations, which includes provision of funding solutions in the form of debt and equity. GCM Capital Advisors Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Mumbai, India.
